subject: GreenLabs — usage-led resize request and short-term buffer proposal
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena@greenlabs.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@greenlabs.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 usage analysis & request to expand dedicated GPUs

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the check-in last week. Attached is our Q3 utilization export (usage_report_q3.csv) and a short summary from our infra team. The headline: we are consistently hitting sustained utilization across our training windows (~78-85% for the primary model pool) and seeing queuing during daily peaks (09:00–13:00 PT). Latency for inference tails into the 400–600ms range under load, which is impacting product SLAs.

Based on the numbers, we'd like to explore two things:
- A short-term buffer to avoid throttling ahead of our product release in mid-November (we estimate +16–32 GPUs needed for the next 8–12 weeks).
- A capacity re-evaluation for the renewal in Jan — we may want to convert part of the buffer into committed capacity if the trend continues.

Can you share an initial sizing recommendation and an estimate for pricing / lead time? Procurement is CC'd and will want formal docs.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Platform
GreenLabs AI

Attachments: usage_report_q3.csv (CSV, 1.2MB)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Elena Gomez <elena@greenlabs.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Procurement <procurement@greenlabs.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 usage analysis & request to expand dedicated GPUs

Elena — thanks for the data and clear ask. Helpful.

Quick read: we can do both a short-term buffer and a path to commit. Looping in Karthik (infra lead) for a technical sizing + immediate mitigations, and Vanessa on commercial (pricing/lead time).

Two options to consider (high level):
1) Short-term burst + buffer: add 16 GPUs to your Dedicated pool immediately (30-day burst policy with autoscale), review after 60–90 days. Faster to deploy, minimal contract changes.
2) Commit increase: bump committed capacity by 40 GPUs starting Jan 1 with a 12-month addendum — lower unit price, but longer procurement lead time.

Karthik — can you confirm whether we should recommend 16 or 32 as the immediate buffer based on the Q3 runs? Also advise any config tweaks (batching, prefix cache) to reduce token-cost pressure while we add capacity.

Vanessa — once Karthik flags the technical plan, can you produce a short quote and outline the amendment steps for Procurement? Procurement, if you can share any internal PO cadence/approval windows, we’ll tailor the timing.

I’ll schedule a 30-min call next week to align.

— Jonas
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Gomez <elena@greenlabs.ai>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Procurement <procurement@greenlabs.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 usage analysis & request to expand dedicated GPUs

Thanks for the data, Elena. I pulled a quick profile from telemetry and did some sanity checks against your reported windows. Short summary below — attaching profiling_summary_oct2026.pdf and a draft amendment outline (draft_amendment_v2.docx) for Vanessa to iterate on.

Observations:
- Peak concurrency correlates with two daily training bursts (09:00–11:30 and 12:30–14:00 PT).
- Average GPU utilization in the primary pool is ~79% outside of the brief warmup period.
- Queue length grows non-linearly when utilization >82% for sustained periods (>20 minutes).

Recommendations (phased):
A) Immediate (deploy within 48–72 hours):
  - Add a 16-GPU buffer to the Dedicated pool and enable burst policy for +16 GPUs (burst will only trigger during peaks).
  - Tune continuous batching and enable prefix/KV caching. Expect a ~12–18% reduction in effective throughput demand after tuning.

B) Short-term review (30–60 days):
  - Re-check utilization and tail-latency post-tuning. If queueing persists during peak windows, prepare to convert 16–32 of the buffer GPUs into committed capacity for Jan renewal.

C) Contract path (commercial):
  - If GreenLabs opts for a commit bump of 40 GPUs, we can offer a 9–12% unit discount on top of existing pricing tiers and guarantee priority provisioning for the rollout. Lead time for committed capacity reallocation is ~3–4 weeks once the addendum is signed.

I’ve included a small list of action items in the attached PDF. Happy to walk through the telemetry on the call.

— Karthik
Infrastructure Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachments: profiling_summary_oct2026.pdf (PDF, 800KB); draft_amendment_v2.docx (DOCX, 120KB)
From: Procurement <procurement@greenlabs.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Q3 usage analysis & request to expand dedicated GPUs

Jonas/Vanessa —

Procurement here. To proceed we need: a formal quote with line-item pricing for (a) a temporary 16-GPU buffer for 90 days, (b) pricing for a 40-GPU committed increase (12-month term), and (c) estimated lead time for each. Please include any cancellation windows and whether the existing commit can be reallocated between pools.

We also need a sample contract amendment and PO template to start approvals — attached is our PO template (greenlabs_po_template.pdf). Our internal approval cycle is 2–3 weeks once we have the quote + contract language.

HubSpot deal ref: #GL-42871. Tax forms and standard SOW addendum requested if the pricing changes.

Thanks,
GreenLabs Procurement

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 usage analysis & request to expand dedicated GPUs

All — thanks for the fast responses. Summary and next steps: 

1) Technical path (agreed): Karthik will provision a 16-GPU buffer and enable burst for an immediate safety margin. He’ll also push the batching + caching tweaks this week and monitor for impact.

2) Commercial path (next 72 hours): Vanessa will send a consolidated quote that includes:
   - Temporary 16-GPU buffer (90 days) — line item
   - 40-GPU committed increase (12-month term) — subscription pricing and proposed discount
   - Lead times & cancellation windows

3) Procurement asks: Vanessa will attach the draft amendment and a DocuSign envelope. Procurement, once you confirm PO cadence we’ll draft the SOW addendum to match.

4) Follow-up cadence: call scheduled Monday 2026-10-12 10:00 PT to review the quote and schedule the amendment sign-off. We’ll reassess commit conversion after 60 days of post-tuning telemetry.

Links and artifacts: consolidated quote + draft amendment will be shared at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-greenlabs-resize and the DocuSign envelope will be provided in Vanessa’s follow-up.

Action items:
- Karthik: provision +16 GPUs and apply tuning (due: 2026-10-10).
- Vanessa: send consolidated quote + DocuSign link (due: 2026-10-11).
- Procurement: confirm PO window and internal approvers (asap).

Happy to jump on the Monday call.

— Jonas
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
